sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:35 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio. All photos and videos will be sent at the end of the shift report.
Debrief with night team regarding the early-morning status of the CBD.
Debrief completed; gearing up and heading out.
Commencing Alpha Route. Arrived at check-in corner of Victoria St East and Queen Street Headquarters. Welfare check, all clear:
Welfare check on stores along Queen Street towards Britomart Square.
Welfare check Durham Street East and West alleyway and stores within both vicinities. All clear.
Welfare check on Vulcan Lane and stores within the vicinity. All clear.
Welfare check Imperial Lane; building sweep around the area. All clear.
Welfare check Queens Arcade. All clear.
Arrived at check-in Commercial Bay; full sweep. All clear.
Standing by to show our presence to morning commuters and the public before moving along.
Ending Alpha Route; commencing Delta Route.
Arrived at check-in Skyworld Entertainment Center and Aotea Square; full sweep. All clear.
Full sweep around Aotea Square. All clear.
Arrived at check-in Auckland Town Hall. All clear.
Tanuki Japanese Sake and Sushi Bar
Arrived at check-in corner of Rutland St and Wakefield St. All clear.
Arrived at check-in corner of Wellesley Street East and Lorne St. All clear.
Welfare check on stores along Lorne Street towards High Street, all clear:
Welfare check on stores along lower High Street towards Shortland Street, all clear:
Arrived at check-in corner of Fort Street and Fort Lane. All clear.
Arrived at check-in Commercial Bay; full sweep. All clear. Ending Delta Route; commencing Echo Route.
Response call from Montblanc: individual sitting outside on a public bench playing music too loud. Assistance requested to ask the individual to turn it down.
Arrived; the individual had already left the area.
Arrived at check-in Queens Arcade. All clear.
Arrived at check-in corner of Shortland St and Queen St. All clear.
Arrived at check-in top of Victoria Street and Federal St. All clear.
Response call from Macca's Queen St: individual outside the store blocking a business advertisement. Assistance requested to ask them to move to a mutual corner outside.
Arrived; spoke to the individual and asked them to move slightly to the side. Individual complied, leaving the area.
While returning to route, received another response call from McDonald's Queen Street: vagrant inside restroom refusing to leave. Assistance requested to move them along from the premises.
Arrived; asked the individual to leave and they complied.
Lunch break completed; standing by for changeover to Afternoon shift.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:50 – 22:00)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone. All photos and videos will be sent at the end of the shift report.
Afternoon shift commencing welfare checks heading up Queen St.
Welfare checks, no issues to report:
Continuing patrol heading up to Aotea.
Sweep completed. No issues. Heading to Victoria Street West.
Welfare check on Victoria Street. No issues. Standing by for security presence.
Standing down from standby. No issues. Heading down Victoria St to Woolworths.
Response call from Recycle Boutique: a theft requesting urgent assistance. Heading there now; informed last seen walking up Queen St.
Vagrants stopped and searched; no stolen items found on their person. Heading back to Recycle Boutique to report.
Reported back to Recycle Boutique; shown footage of what was taken (a black puffer jacket and a small item). Heading back out to look for the vagrants again.

Found the vagrant by the Auckland Library and repeatedly asked to give the jacket back; vagrant was hesitant and not complying, and other vagrants tried to intervene. Managed to retrieve the stolen item before any escalation. No further issues. Heading back to boutique.
Item returned. No further issues. Resuming patrol down Queen St.
Local businesses on lower Queen St clear. No issues. Continuing to Commercial Bay.
Welfare sweep on Commercial Bay clear. No issues. Heading to Fort / Gore St.
Quick walkthrough Commerce / Tyler St clear. No issues.
Welfare sweep on Gore St. No issues. Site checks:
Fort St sweep complete. No issues. Site checks:
High St sweep complete. No issues on Shortland St / Vulcan Lane. Currently sweeping Freyberg Square before Chancery.
Freyberg Sq sweep complete. No issues. Currently sweeping Chancery Square.
Chancery Sq welfare sweep clear. No issues. Site checks complete. Completing patrol on High St.
High St sweep completed. No issues. Heading back onto Queen St to maintain security.
Response call from McDonald's Queen St requesting assistance as there is a vagrant onsite causing issues with the venue. Making our way now.
Arrived; the vagrant had already moved along. No further issue. Heading back to HQ.
Stopped and asked to stand by Footlocker as they had POIs onsite. Standing by.
POIs have taken leave. No issues to report.
Commencing security presence patrol as well as keeping an eye out for issues.
Patrol on upper Queen St complete. No issues found.
Aotea Square sweep complete. Heading to Elliot St.
Elliott St / Darby St welfare checks clear. No issues.
Heading back to HQ for our break and 1st guard stand down.
2nd guard standing down; debriefing with handover guard before departing. No further issues.
Charging ops work phone; standing by in office (percentage shown on work camera) responding to any calls.
Commencing patrol till guard handover; patrolling upper Queen Street.
Welfare check on McDonald's, 77 Convenience Store, Avachi, ChaCha Panda, Hulucat, Timezone. All clear. Heading up to Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square; commencing full sweep.
Full sweep Aotea Square. Heading down to pick up swipe for HQ.
Keytag pickup. All clear. Heading down to Elliot Stables for a full sweep and welfare check.
Full sweep Darby Street, Elliot Street; welfare check on Elliot Stables. All clear. Due to bad weather we will be heading back to HQ.
Arrived at HQ; standing by in office to charge ops phone and night shift handover; responding to calls while waiting.
Afternoon shift concluded; handing over to night shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:00 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Body Cameras, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone. All photos and videos will be sent at the end of the shift report.
Ops phone currently on charge; standing by in office responsive to calls while waiting.
Commencing floor checks then heading out to patrols.
Arrived at Bar101; standing by showing presence due to a lot of foot traffic in the area.
Confiscated alcohol from a female individual. All clear. No issues to report. Continuing patrols down Queen Street.
Full sweep Queen Street, Fort Street, Fort Lane, Shortland Street; welfare check on Shortland Mart, KFC, Sapphire Nightclub. All clear. Heading down to Britomart.
Arrived at Britomart; commencing full sweep.
Full sweep Britomart; welfare check McDonald's and guard. All clear. Not much foot traffic around the area.
Welfare check Kemuri and Reign N Pour. All clear.
Full sweep Quay Street. All clear.

Encountered a male adult pulling out plants from the sidewalk and causing a disturbance. Approached and kindly asked him to stop; a lot of public viewers shouting and cussing at the male, so standing by in case of any potential fight.
Stand down standby; public viewers have left the scene and the male individual has left also. All clear. Continuing patrols.
Welfare check Britomart McDonald's; full sweep. All clear. Patrolling through Queen Street.
Successfully removed alcohol from a male individual drinking in public. All clear. No further issues.
Queen Street all clear. No issues. Heading to Queen Street McDonald's.
Full sweep McDonald's Queen Street. All clear. Heading to Bar101 and standing by till closing.
Arrived at Bar101; showing our presence in the area and maintaining safety.
Removed alcohol from a male individual drinking on the side of his car.
Welfare check Bar101. All clear. No further issues.
Check on Darby St, Elliott Street. All clear.
Patrolling up Victoria St. All clear.
Welfare check on 77 Convenience Store. All clear.
Patrolling Federal St to St Patrick's Cathedral and Federal Square. All clear.
Check Federal Street; full sweep Cathedral, Federal and St Patrick Square. All clear. Patrolling down Wyndham St towards Queen St.
Queen Street all clear. Patrolling Fort Lane, Fort St and the bottom of High St. All clear.
Fort Lane, Fort Street all clear. Welfare check on High St Supermarket. All clear.
Full sweep around Chancery Square and Freyberg Square. All clear.

Received a response call from McDonald's Queen Street: a male vagrant sleeping inside the premises. Staff asked him nicely to leave as they are closing but he aggressively declined. On route to location.

Arrived; male vagrant was sleeping inside the premises. Approached and kindly asked him to leave; he was fully compliant but was in agonising pain and requested emergency services. Assisted the vagrant with going outside; on standby outside calling emergency services for the vagrant.
Emergency services have arrived; standing by for any assistance needed.
Security assistance stand down. All clear. No issues to report.
Received a response call from McDonald's Britomart: a group of minors shouting at staff and refusing to leave the premises. On route to response location.

Arrived; staff requested the group of minors and everyone inside out. Everyone was very compliant, including the group of minors. Everyone escorted out and staff secured the lobby area. No further issues. Heading back to HQ to commence 30-minute break and guard handover.
Arrived at HQ; commencing 30-minute break and responding to any response calls.
Handover to morning shift. Night shift concluded.
